changes.title: Zoo polish
items: A little treehouse just north of the zoo's middle is the way out: walk up to it and press E (exit)
Flying or walking off the zoo's edge takes you out of it too, with a short fade
The zoo's middle shows the World Tree as an old carving in the flagstones: thin, worn grooves with a faint mint light in them
At the zoo's edge the water races out to a bright crest and pours off into space

changes.title: Thorn scrub
items: The spider's holly thicket is now a thorn scrub on the edge of the badlands: thorn trees, hawthorns and junipers on dry brown earth, cobwebs strung between

changes.title: Invitations brooms
items: Before the party, take tonight's invitations from the desk in the Parlour (E): without them your 💌s and your Sentry hat throw nothing
Take a broom from the lathe in the Workshop (E): without one, step off the Terrace and you fall, thud, and come back at the magic circle
The invitations desk is bigger, messier and covered in 💌s; three plain brooms wait at the lathe, one for each witch
A pin points you to the invitations desk, then to the lathe, before the party
The Terrace's magic circle is bigger and carries the World Tree's sigil
